description:
Use this Fandango app directly within ChatGPT to discover movies, browse showtimes, and plan your next movie night - all in one conversation.

Find what to watch with recommendations, explore new and upcoming releases, and search by movie, theater, or location.  See real-time showtimes, making it easy to decide and act in the moment. Plus, check out Rotten Tomatoes scores instantly!

Fandango brings together content, recommendations, and ticketing to power a complete moviegoing experience from conversation to checkout. 

At Fandango, We Love Fans.
